From the top floor of the building, I realized I was saying goodbye.
August 3rd, Thursday. A wound in my heart,
The sixth wound. Torn to shreds, break it all.
All.

Meeting you, I noticed for the first time my foolishness,
Without being able to trust people, I am hurting people.
Why again do I love you, unrepentantly?
Like this, it seems I cannot forget to love.
But
Believing is painful, without noticing,
I was crying alone, so you wouldn't know.

Any more than this, any more than this, I don't want to be hurt.
But right now, I only wanted to love you.

There were times I tried to forget, but now I want to hold you tight.

Believing is painful. I learned of your past.
What I can't forget is
Actually, it's your side.

Any more than this, any more than this, I don't want to be hurt.
But I cannot strongly hold only you.
August 5th. In the clear, cloudless sky,
